caption: The drawing depicts a single knee-length dress with three-quarter-length sleeves, displayed upright on a plain, light beige background with no other objects or decor. The dress is rendered in shades of light brown and beige, with fine, horizontal linework giving the fabric a textured appearance. The garment features a round neckline and a fitted upper bodice that flares out gently at the skirt. Decorative, symmetrical embroidery in darker brown is present at the sleeve cuffs and in a larger, ornate pattern along the lower hem of the dress. There is also a scalloped lace edge at the very hem. The composition is centered, and the artist’s signature “MARIE FAWIARE” is faintly visible beneath the dress.
title: Infant's Dress
